scope: Label-blind measurement feasibility on the adaptive Okutama development source. No action classifier, model selection from labels, performance claim, or originality claim.
objective: Determine whether native aerial frames support reproducible actor-region correspondences, held-background camera compensation, coherent actor translation, and within-actor residual motion before authorizing full P8 extraction.

p7_result.decision: P7 did not improve P6; move to a genuinely new physical correspondence source.

metadata_contract.bbox_coordinates: already in native 1280x720 pixel-edge scene coordinates; do not divide by three
metadata_contract.center_geometry_check: P0_r1 and P3 center-frame identity, member, dimensions, and box coordinates must match exactly for all 4977 rows

selection.scenario_allocation: 11 per scenario plus one extra for the seven scenarios with smallest SHA256(hash_domain+'scenario:'+scenario)
selection.size_allocation: allocate large then small targets by deterministic scenario round-robin with availability and scenario quotas; assign remaining slots to medium
selection.incomplete_allocation: allocate exactly 12 incomplete slots by deterministic nonempty scenario-size-cell round-robin, preserving enough complete candidates
selection.within_cell_order: iteratively minimize already-selected count for provider recording plus track, then SHA256(hash_domain+'sample:'+sample_id), then sample_id

runtime.rng: derive the pair seed from the first 31 bits of SHA256(hash_domain+sample_id+':pair:'+time_index); use it for H1 and pair_seed+1 modulo 2^31 for H2
runtime.decode: cv2.imdecode grayscale at native resolution; no resizing or crop recentering

background_correspondence.known_actor_exclusion: exclude the union of all valid actor boxes present in the locked P3 frame manifest for that JPEG member, expanded by 10 native pixels, at both correspondence endpoints
background_correspondence.limitation: the manifest union contains all known eligible boxes, not a guarantee that every visible person is masked
background_correspondence.partition_rule: within each source spatial cell sort retained points by y then x; index modulo five 0 is model-selection, modulo five 1 is final audit, and 2/3/4 are fit points

actor_correspondence.name_limitation: points inside an annotated actor box are actor-region correspondences, not verified body or anatomical points
actor_correspondence.seed_region: source box eroded by 10 percent on each side

camera_hypotheses.homography_pole_and_orientation_guard: all four image-corner homogeneous denominators must be finite, nonzero, and have one sign; projected corners must stay within the declared bounds; local Jacobian determinants at the corners and center must be finite and strictly positive
camera_hypotheses.selection: begin H0; upgrade H0 to H1 only if held-background median error improves by at least 0.25 pixels and 20 percent; upgrade the retained simpler model to H2 under the same two conditions; never use actor displacement to select the camera model

motion_decomposition.camera_residual: q - project(H,p) in native scene pixels
motion_decomposition.actor_scale: geometric mean of positive adjacent box heights
motion_decomposition.normalized_velocity: camera residual divided by actor_scale and elapsed_time
motion_decomposition.missing_measurement: retain explicit failure and reliability fields; emit null, never observed zero, for translation or articulation quantities whose required support or camera gate failed

engineering_gates.camera_pair_usable: at least 40 retained background correspondences across at least 6/12 cells, at least 8 model-selection and 8 disjoint final-audit points; choose H0/H1/H2 only on model-selection points, then require final-audit median error <= 1 pixel and p90 <= 2 pixels; when final-audit H0 median displacement exceeds 2 pixels require selected-model reduction >= 50 percent
engineering_gates.translation_pair_usable: camera pair usable and at least 4 primary actor-region correspondences
engineering_gates.articulation_pair_usable: translation pair usable and at least 6 primary actor-region correspondences spanning at least 2/3 vertical regions
engineering_gates.clip_usable: at least 10 of all 15 requested adjacent pairs are articulation-pair usable; missing source frames count as failed requested pairs
engineering_gates.center_track_survival_fraction: report fraction of center-seeded points surviving at least 75 percent of the 15 requested links; no gate

decision_rule.full_ccac_extraction: all camera, overall clip, scenario, and size-band gates pass
decision_rule.narrow_translation_or_tracker_pilot: full extraction failed, camera gate passed, and either translation clip coverage is at least 0.5 or articulation clip coverage is at least 0.5; authorize one bounded tracker/translation review only
decision_rule.abandon_initial_lk_extractor: all other outcomes, including failure of the camera gate or both translation and articulation clip coverage below 0.5

prior_art_context.interpretation: Sparse LK, robust camera fitting, and point tracking are established. A contribution would require controlled shared-failure repair and independent transfer, not method naming.
